sharedRules.P20-CASTING-01: Reuse actual class-access/repertoire, paid costs, component, concentration and Dissonance/Refrain procedures from the exact registry. None of these drafts grants a new class row, rank, upcast or resource maximum. A continuous field, stored rider or command does not itself cast again. Actual target/caster predicates are rechecked at the source-defined checkpoint, without refund or diagnostic disclosure from hidden failure.
sharedRules.P20-DIGITAL-GEOMETRY-01: NEW bounded clarification for these 20 proposals: measure the actual occupied body against the continuous authored volume/surface, with actual cover/line of effect. Five-foot lengths remain real lengths, not a rounding of positions onto tabletop squares. Source-authored five-foot destructible/fuel partitions remain fixed object identities; changing path sampling, zoom or visual mesh subdivision cannot create more targets, HP or exposure. Evaluate a genuine entry at the first boundary crossing/contact, resolve it once before continuing the same trajectory, and preserve actual remaining movement. Teleport crosses no intermediate path; an arrival can trigger only a source explicitly authorizing arrival. Snapshot simultaneous recipients once before their consequences; destroyed cover creates no second wave.
sharedRules.P20-CLOCKS-01: NEW explicit cohort bindings: absolute field deadlines are resolution+60 seconds where the procedure states one minute; expiry wins at equality. Source-owned pulses at resolution and +6 through +54 do not require a caster turn or grant a creature turn. A finite target/source marker schedule records its original regular markers at creation under accepted time ordering; reorder, extra turns and departure preserve the original virtual schedule, six seconds apart. Explicit future-turn endpoints exclude an in-progress turn/phase; an ending save expressly including current END keeps that exception. At START, apply accepted expiry/recovery/death-save ordering before periodic damage. At END, due damage/eligible ending saves precede that source endpoint cleanup, except a card explicitly expires before its redundant last save. Suppression consumes a due scheduled opportunity with no damage or catch-up. Ended creature identities have no recipient; administrative deadline bookkeeping never resurrects one.
sharedRules.P20-ATTACHED-PHASE-01: NEW source-specific bridge for the target-clock proposals in this cohort, not a general companion turn: an owner-attached recipient uses the original owner regular attached-phase beginning/end only for the stated spell packet or ending save. A future phase excludes one already underway. If no such real phase exists, retain a six-second spell-only checkpoint and finite original endpoint. This checkpoint supplies only a due packet/save or expiry that the spell actually grants; it supplies no Action, movement, Bonus Action, Reaction refresh, recharge, or ordinary death save. Source-required real Action/command maintenance cannot execute at an administrative checkpoint. Root identity, prior spent exposures, endpoint and finite tick count survive controller or schedule changes.
sharedRules.P20-FAMILY-EXPOSURE-01: NEW per-source anti-duplication applies only where the individual procedure names a family cap: record target identity, named spell family, explicit category and numbered round. Different owners/casts share that named ledger; distinct spell names and explicitly separate Wall of Fire categories do not merge. Outside initiative use the scene continuing six-second exposure cycle, fixed before the relevant exposure. Preserve its spent state through a transition to the current combat round until that mapped interval ends; never refresh just by changing timing mode. Immunity/save/prevention after actual admission still consumes the exposure; wholly suppressed or geometrically ineligible sources cannot claim it. Simultaneous eligible sources use established application order then stable identity. Immolation instead uses the already accepted ongoing-fire arbitration at each identical target marker.
sharedRules.P20-DAMAGE-FUNDING-01: Reuse actual typed defenses, temporary HP, HP floors, Wounds, concentration, death/Null life order and one original recipient event. No inferred damage amount from structural failure or overkill. ActualDamageDealt remains real tempHP absorption plus normal HP loss. Healing/funding is a separate consumer: first exclude any terminal branch whose actual transfer/source flag forbids derived healing or recovery, then apply the spell-specific donor predicate, sum eligible branches once and floor the half once. Never count a split parent again. Burden Shared and Life Linked restrictions remain operative; a numeric branch amount alone is not funding permission. Preserve the distinct pending Leeching Plague donor exclusions and Enervation wider proposal for explicit Director disposition.
sharedRules.P20-RNG-INFORMATION-01: Authored dice are engine RNG. Original component identity, draw method, save factor and cached ordinal value remain private engine state unless an actual separately accepted presentation policy grants the exact disclosure. This candidate grants no new public dice viewer, hidden-target list, successful-save feedback, enemy-identity scan or Fate eligibility. Shared damage dice do not merge recipient roots. The accepted exact DE4 five-entry presentation policy applies only where its actual source predicates pass; it does not automatically disclose any private periodic, delayed, penalty or random-selection operation in this cohort. An actual qualifying OVERT-ATTACK d20 can use that entry without exposing a hidden Synaptic Static d6, hidden modifier cause or later damage pool. No sixth presentation entry is proposed here. No RNG seed or future draw is exposed. If a source has no admitted recipient and no explicit source-authored event-generation rule, do not invent a damage event merely to publish a roll.
sharedRules.P20-ROOT-01: Every damage source uses its explicit pending per-source mapping in damageRootProposals. These are NEW decisions requiring concurrence; accepted Forbiddance/Chain Arc/Skybrand and lower nightmare rules do not silently generalize. Root creation alone spends no Action, deals no damage, triggers no Wound, generates no material, and grants no hidden information. Pure transfer retains flags; an attached component can retain an old flag while a genuinely new operated attack creates its own root. Physical fire and Sonic debris mappings are bounded to the exact finite proposed outputs.
sharedRules.P20-SUPPRESSION-01: Reuse the exact actual suppressor/removal source. Lesser Antimagic, rank limits and source versus expression tests keep their accepted scope. AC6 Globe is not general antimagic: its fixed boundary blocks only its actual incoming rank-0–5 source cases, does not ban all internal casting, and does not erase an already attached buff merely because a creature enters. A fixed external ongoing field and a target-attached rider have different origin facts. A spell object is not a creature; physical Inferno fuel/rubble after actual creation is not a sustained magical field. No suppression pauses a deadline or restores a destroyed body, cleared crystal patch, spent shot or old command.

spells.procedure: Action; V/S/F; instantaneous wave, no concentration. KEEP 60-foot line and 6d6 fire. NEW: a straight line from the caster, five feet wide and five feet high, in a declared direction; being its origin alone does not include the caster. Stop at a total solid obstruction. Snapshot all eligible creatures, each making DEX for full 6d6 fire on failure or half on success, with one shared raw roll. The wave itself has no general object-damage packet. KEEP its distinct ground-ignition clause: after the snapshot, ignite genuinely exposed combustible ground/floor material intersecting this footprint, including dry surface vegetation or an actually burnable wooden surface. Bare stone, water, saturated ground and unsupported air supply no fuel. NEW finite small-fire completion: divide actual ignited footprint into at most twelve five-foot patches, each clipped to the line and its available fuel. Before applying a patch, record the real combustible substrate, the finite amount that actually ignites, its physical burn endpoint no later than sixty seconds after ignition, and actual extinguishing method. If available fuel burns out sooner, use that earlier endpoint; no invented fuel mass, structural HP loss or total floor collapse follows from the spell. Each patch is an ordinary physical flame, not a continuing spell or Core Burning applied to a creature. It remains until fuel/endpoint or real extinguishing, independently of caster concentration, dispel or suppression of other magic. NEW hazard: a creature in contact with its burning surface takes 1d6 fire without a save on first actual entry or its regular START there, at most once per Inferno-ground-fire family/target/round across all patches and owners. A creature eligible for the initial wave counts as exposed to this family for that same round even if its save/defenses prevent damage; it takes no second immediate ground packet. No creation pulse, airborne heat damage or extra-turn START is added. A wholly suppressed original cast creates neither wave nor ignition; suppression after actual ignition cannot unburn material. Real dousing or complete smothering can end a contacted patch; one adjacent creature may spend an Action using actual sufficient water, sand or a usable nonburning cover to extinguish one patch, with no roll and no fabricated equipment. A source effect such as Tidal Wave can extinguish the ordinary flames it genuinely contacts. NEW conservative fire boundary: these patches do not automatically spread or persist past their recorded endpoint. Continued/spreading environmental fire requires a separately established ordinary hazard and remaining real fuel, never a fresh spell packet or free manufactured stock. Reignition is possible only for actual remaining unburned material and never resets a current round exposure.

spells.procedure:
Action; V/S/F. KEEP the casting-point range of 30 feet separately from the 30-foot radius and the 4d6 cold per round. NEW replace the contradictory Instantaneous duration with concentration up to sixty elapsed seconds. Choose a perceived point within range with line of effect; create a fixed vertical cylinder thirty feet in radius and twenty feet high, centered vertically on that point. Its volume and affected surfaces are clipped by actual solid cover from the center; rain does not cross a roof or sealed floor by name alone. All legal creatures in that volume make CON at creation, then at each source six-second pulse before expiry. Roll shared 4d6 cold for each pulse: full on failure, half on success. NEW family cap: initial and periodic cold together affect a target at most once per Freezing Rain identity per round across owners/casts. Each pulse takes a fresh geometry/cover snapshot. Entry, forced movement, reentry, extra turns or suppression ending adds no cold tick; entering can expose a creature at the next genuine pulse. Damage is independent of the slippery ground. NEW slippery surface: actual exposed walkable surfaces inside the active cylinder cost double ground movement, using ordinary difficult-terrain arbitration without multiplying an existing double cost. At the first voluntary ground-movement expenditure on a covered surface in a round, after the first up-to-five-feet segment, make DEX against the first encountered active rain’s recorded DC; failure applies Prone if the creature can receive it. This slip check is family once/target/round, shared across casts, walking and attempts to stand then move. Already Prone creatures spend the same opportunity but receive no additional condition; ordinary crawling and standing costs remain. Standing alone does not trigger it, and forced movement, falling, flight and teleportation do not themselves spend ground Speed or force a slip save. A failed creature still chooses how to use remaining legal movement/actions. The rain supplies no Frozen, restrained body, attack penalty or magical Speed reduction; terrain therefore is not a Balanced Elements slow. Suppression removes only that source’s active cold/terrain effects while original clocks and spent history continue. At ending, all its magical rain and slipperiness vanish, with no residual ice, drinking water, repair material or harvestable stock. Existing mundane weather and unrelated terrain remain.

CURRENT MOVEMENT PRECISION — NEW P20-RAIN-CONTACT-07, Freezing Rain only: For the first continuous voluntary ground trajectory contacting an operative covered surface in a numbered round, accumulate actual contacted distance, not nominal Speed expenditure. Resolve the one DEX slip check at the earliest of (a) five actual contacted feet, (b) a genuine earlier voluntary stop, or (c) the boundary at which that continuous contacted portion ends because the continuing voluntary trajectory leaves all operative Freezing Rain-covered surface. Under (c), resolve the check after paying the contacted distance and before spending movement on the outside continuation. A zero-duration frame/input split is not a stop or a coverage exit; touching or crossing internal patch/owner boundaries without leaving the union of operative covered surface does not reset the accumulator. At a geometric contact-loss boundary use the completed contacted path length up to that boundary; no epsilon distance grants a second check or free travel. A one-foot real move followed by a stop checks after that foot. A short exit without stopping likewise checks before outside continuation; it cannot evade the check solely by leaving before five feet. If movement remains wholly within covered surface and has not stopped, retain the accumulated length across frame and command subdivisions until one of the stated checkpoints occurs. Standing alone, teleportation, airborne motion, Falling and forced movement still do not themselves generate this voluntary ground-slip check. A failed check applies actual Prone without refund; continuation requires the creature's then-legal crawling, standing and movement budgets. The family once-per-target/per-round opportunity is shared across owners and remains spent even when Prone immunity prevents the consequence. This is not a global slip rule or a Crystalline Growth timing change.

spells.procedure:
KEEP Action, 60-foot point range, V/S/F, instantaneous 8d8 thunder area damage and collapse of weak structures. NEW choose a perceived point with line of effect and a 20-foot-radius sphere. Snapshot all creatures and eligible ordinary nonmagical objects/structural sections with center line of effect. Creatures, including allies and the caster when actually in the sphere, make CON: failure takes the shared 8d8 thunder; success takes half, rounded down. Each eligible object/section receives the shared 8d8 as one thunder packet against its actual material defenses and durability, without a save. No separate object-bonus die is added.

Use Shatter's reviewed object-admission and structural identity rule: unattended objects, caster-held objects or items deliberately offered by willing holders; hostile worn/carried equipment is not separately damaged. For each actual structural whole, select one contiguous exposed section wholly within the sphere, bounded by a five-foot cube, containing the reachable point nearest the center. Stable neutral geometry resolves equal choices before rolling; naming each brick or panel separately does not multiply one building's packets. An independently profiled freestanding structure or object remains genuinely distinct. Hidden boundaries are Director records, not information revealed by casting.

NEW a selected section is weak if its already established structural record marks it unstable/weak with a finite failure profile, or it is ordinary nonmagical wood, packed earth or crumbling masonry no more than one foot thick and already at or below half of its actual structural maximum HP before this blast. Missing durability is not treated as zero or automatically weak; establish the real object's finite profile before committing a spell that depends on it. Do not retrospectively invent damage or a weak support to reward a cast. Resolve thunder damage first. Any selected section actually reduced to structural zero fails normally. In addition, a prequalified weak section suffering positive post-defense thunder from this spell collapses even if its numeric HP would otherwise remain positive. Mark its structural integrity failed/zero without treating the extra loss as another damage packet or a resource-generating DamageDealt amount. Immunity preventing all its thunder means this extra collapse clause has no trigger.

After the original blast finishes, resolve real unsupported material and body falls. An existing finite structure/hazard profile controls the actual failure footprint, connected supports, height, escape and damage; a large cascade must be supported by that preexisting profile, not generated by recursively treating all newly exposed architecture as a new spell target. NEW fallback for a local weak section without a separate debris attack: its real falling material creates at most one debris event in that section's horizontal footprint plus five feet, and only up to twenty vertical feet below it. Affected creatures make DEX, taking a shared 2d6 bludgeoning on failure or half on success. Each creature receives this fallback at most once per cast, even when separate sections overlap. The same mass does not also create a second collision packet. Actual creatures losing support instead use their one ordinary Fall Marker; the same bodily fall is not counted again as the fallback debris event. No automatic burial, Prone, pinning, suffocation or arbitrary crush multiplier is supplied. A scenario requiring larger structural effects needs an explicit finite hazard before commitment; this preserves real building consequences without granting limitless spell propagation.

Rubble retains the actual source matter, provenance and damage. It is difficult terrain and offers cover only where its actual remaining geometry supplies it. It persists until real clearing, transport or repair work changes it. The spell does not rebuild a structure after expiry, conjure extra salvage, cleanse material, damage a magical force wall, deafen creatures or keep damaging later entrants.

spells.procedure:
KEEP Action, 60 feet, V/S/M-or-F, heavily obscured area and enemies inside taking 3d6 necrotic per round. Preserve Core Instantaneous as the explicit unresolved metadata conflict. NEW choose a perceived center within range/line of effect and form one fixed 20-foot-radius sphere, concentration up to 60 elapsed seconds. It is a magical obscuring field, not collectible blood, poison, inhaled gas, a corpse or a hydration/recipe supply. Ordinary wind alone does not disperse this field; an actual effect explicitly dispersing magical fog or suppressing/removing its source retains its real scope. The caster cannot move the center after creation.

The entire operative field heavily obscures normal vision for everyone, including allies and caster. A line of sight through its interior is obstructed according to the actual vision rules; this does not create physical cover or block physical line of effect, hearing or a genuinely applicable nonvisual sense. True Seeing's illusion/darkness benefits do not see through this actual magical obscuration by default, since this proposal does not define it as a false visual image or darkness. The fog does not automatically hide a known location, grant its occupants Invisible, erase attack evidence or bypass the actual perception requirement for a sight-targeted spell.

At creation, snapshot all creatures actually inside with center line of effect that the caster genuinely regards as enemies from existing information. Each makes CON; failure takes the shared rolled 3d6 necrotic, success half rounded down. At later actual regular target STARTs while eligible inside, or on first actual entry in a numbered round, apply that same procedure. Across every Blood Fog application/caster, each creature receives at most one damage/save opportunity per numbered round, including creation. Mark the exposure before its save/damage, including successful saves or complete prevention. Choose the earliest operative eligible source when multiple fields qualify simultaneously. Entering/reentering, being pushed out/back, extra turns or changing controller does not clear the history. A cast cannot reveal a hidden creature's presence to its caster merely because that creature is damaged.

Enemy classification is evaluated at the actual opportunity from the caster's genuine existing knowledge, not an objective secret hostility or alignment test. A known enemy currently unseen can qualify; an entirely unknown creature is not automatically identified as one. A recipient that becomes eligible later receives no retroactive damage and needs an actual future START/entry opportunity. Area obscuration applies regardless of that damage predicate or immunity. No inhalation, blood-bearing anatomy or living-only gate is added to damage; actual necrotic defenses still determine results. Corpse/object contents are not damage recipients and provide no healing, residue or new creature event.

Outside initiative use one possible creation packet followed by six-second regular spell pulse opportunities for occupants; entering has its normal family exposure check in that shared six-second interval. On entering initiative, map the next unresolved periodic opportunity to the next actual regular START, retain the original deadline/exposure ledger, and add no transition packet. Suppressed opportunities are lost, not banked; resumption itself is neither entry nor START. Leaving the area ends exposure to obscuration/damage without ending the field. Concentration loss, actual removal or expiry ends the entire source. One Blood Fog per caster; a new genuinely formed field replaces the prior one, while ordinary concentration displacement can already have ended it. New paid casts never reset the named-family per-recipient exposure history.

completeEarlierRecordUnchanged.procedure:
KEEP both source placements, Action, 60 feet, V/S/F and concentration up to one minute. NEW choose one willing creature, including yourself, perceived within 60 feet and line of effect. The casting range selects that recipient; a separate NEW 60-foot sensory extent moves with its actual body. Combine both preserved placements' explicit benefits into this single identity: darkness, all illusions, invisibility, shapechanges and transmutations. This proposed union does not grant an unacquired school or class mode. There is no save for a willing recipient, and the benefit requires no continuing range tether to the caster.

Within the extent and actual unobstructed sensory path, the recipient sees normally through ordinary or magical darkness, sees actually Invisible creatures/objects, and perceives sensory illusions as identifiable false overlays. Darkness removal is observer-specific and casts no light for others. It does not penetrate actual opaque barriers, physical smoke/fog or opaque mundane material. Blinded or missing usable sight still prevents sight; darkness alone is bypassed, not the Blinded condition. Normal hearing or another genuinely functioning sense can identify an illusory sound/tactile impression whose actual apparent source lies within the extent and accessible sensory path, without gaining hearing while Deafened or receiving messages through walls. An existing remote sensor does not acquire this effect or move its extent; its own express sharing rules must supply any separate permission.

NEW the recipient sees the underlying original appearance beneath an actually operative shapechange/transmutation, including an ongoing permanent form spell. The body remains in its current mechanical form with its actual HP, anatomy, equipment and permissions. This reveals appearance only, not a name, history, alignment, motives, creature statistics, identity documents or lost earlier transformations. A completed instantaneous conversion that now leaves ordinary matter supplies no ongoing false form to pierce. Seeing an original silhouette does not find hidden objects inside the body or restore missing matter. Physical concealment/Hidden still needs ordinary detection; an invisible creature is not automatically found through cover. Once genuinely seen, its Invisible-specific unseen modifiers are bypassed for this observer within the benefit's scope.

For current visual illusions, this is conclusive personal identification without an examination Action. Identification removes only perception-dependent deception and any consequence whose own source explicitly ends on disbelief. It does not dispel the source for other observers or cancel an independently specified psychic packet, fear relation or compulsion. NEW explicit bridge to the unadopted Mental Prison proposal: a recipient seeing through its own subjective prison leaves that illusion mentally; the prison's one still-live ordinary exit packet resolves under its own rule, rather than treating True Seeing as antimagic. Greater Phantasmal Killer's independent damage proposal and Spectral Army's explicit detonation remain capable of damage. These cross-proposal choices await joint review. Concentration ending, expiry, actual removal or recipient death ends this sight. Suppression suspends it while the clock continues. Separate True Seeing sources add no range and retain independent endings; renewed paid casts grant no new knowledge beyond present actual perception.
workedCases: IN6-01-A: A willing ally 45 feet away receives True Seeing. It can see an actually exposed Invisible foe 50 feet from its own body in magical darkness; the caster's later distance is irrelevant. A second foe behind a stone wall is not revealed. The recipient gains neither a new targeting line through that wall nor the foe's name or alignment, and ordinary companions receive no shared sight.

IN6-01-B: A creature in an operative transformed body is seen as both its current form and its underlying original appearance. Its current mechanical form and HP remain. Seeing through an ongoing private Mental Prison is the proposed mental departure and can trigger that prison's one live exit packet; it does not suppress that payload. An instantaneous rock-to-mud result does not reveal a complete geological history.
completeEarlierRecordUnchanged.newChoices: NEW willing recipient plus 60-foot sensory extent, explicit union of both placements, source-bounded nonvisual identification, underlying-appearance limit and precise cross-proposal disbelief/damage interfaces.
completeEarlierRecordUnchanged.originalQuestion: Preserve BOTH placements: Divination sees through ALL illusions, invisibility and SHAPECHANGES; Illusion sees through DARKNESS, illusions and TRANSMUTATIONS. Both Core entries give Action/60ft/concentration up to1minute. Resolve whether60ft is recipient casting range, sensory extent or both, who receives the sight, actual sight/line of effect and three-dimensional geometry. Preserve the additional darkness and transmutation wording explicitly rather than silently selecting one school. Define the perceived information about a transformed body versus its actual mechanical form, ongoing hidden objects and nonvisual illusions. Seeing through does not itself dispel a spell, restore the original body, grant true names/alignment/history or penetrate physical opaque barriers. Reconcile exact disbelief/illusion and invisibility modifiers, concealment, suppression, blind observers, remote sensors and actual form changes. No unrestricted cosmic knowledge or planar sight is implied.

iceStormMixedDefenseOption.completeProposedText:
NEW P20-ICE-MIXED-07 — Ice Storm only. Preserve one simultaneous original-recipient damage event with bludgeoning and cold subamounts. Roll each printed 4d6 pool once for the cast. Apply the stated save factor to each type and floor each half separately. The following distribution rule grants no defense and changes no defense's eligibility, required activation, actual flat amount, frequency or explicitly stated before/after-resistance stage.

For competing flat damage reductions governed by CLASS_PLAYTEST_RULES.md, select only the strongest applicable flat amount for this event, not one winner at each stage. An explicit after-resistance clause changes the selected source's stage; it does not independently authorize stacking with another competing class flat reduction. If equal amounts from different sources remain tied and no exact accepted priority decides them, NEW Ice-Storm-only tie completion: use ascending immutable source-card ID, then original owner ID and application ID. Freeze that selection before allocation and do not optimize it using later resistance, temporary HP, Wounds, or the player's preferred outcome. Independent barriers, explicit reductions outside that strongest-class-DR arbitration and real sharing operations retain their separate source permissions and stages; this rule neither creates them nor deletes them.

At the selected source's actual reduction stage, aggregate all currently eligible amounts of the same canonical damage type. Let B=min(the selected source's flat reduction, the sum of its eligible nonnegative typed amounts). Allocate B in exact rational proportion to those amounts. Give each type the floor of its share, then assign remaining integer points to the largest fractional remainders, with exact ties in ascending canonical damage-type ID. A zero amount receives no allocation. Splitting one type into dice or rows cannot change the result. Do not reduce any component below zero, apply a source's flat amount once per type, or select an allocation using later immunity/resistance. Use exact rationals or equivalent integer arithmetic, not floating-point tie guesses.

An ordinary selected class reduction resolves before resistance/immunity; then apply each actual typed defense and round under its source. A selected Spinal Plating or other exact after-resistance reduction acts on the amounts remaining after that stage instead. Retain surviving typed lineage through any actual later barrier, sharing or transfer. Resolve one grouped original-recipient temporary-HP/HP/Wound/zero event. Transfer recipients retain only their own actual lifecycle consequences and source flags. There is no extra cast, attack, save, Wound trigger, copied payment or fresh Null root merely because this packet contains two types. This rule is separately proposed for Ice Storm; the pending Meteor option is historical comparison, not its authority, and no other mixed-damage spell inherits it.
